item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena and Arjun measure the length of the same classroom table using their handspans. Meena counts 6 handspans, but Arjun counts 8 handspans. The table has not changed length.
What is the correct reason for the different counts?

options.A: The table becomes longer when Arjun measures it.
options.B: Meena and Arjun have handspans of different lengths, so the same length gives different counts.
options.C: A handspan is the same length for every student, so one of them must have counted wrong.
options.D: Arjun counts more handspans because his handspan is longer than Meena's.
